decisive_items: Dermal neutrophilia and microabscesses with eosinophilia
response.rationale: Vegetative pyoderma gangrenosum best fits the vegetating pustular plaques with pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia and mixed dermal neutrophilic/eosinophilic microabscesses. Sweet syndrome typically presents with acute febrile edematous plaques and diffuse dermal neutrophilia, not the described vegetative, bleeding, eosinophil-rich lesions.

rejected.why: Sweet syndrome is less consistent because the vignette lacks characteristic fever/edematous plaques and instead emphasizes vegetating lesions, pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia, and eosinophil-rich microabscesses.
